Leah (Marketing Ops): Launch checklist for May 18 webinar. Need final reg page, Zoom record + SRT, replay gating plan, and HS routing by Mon EOD.
Dan (Growth): Proposal: two CTAs visible on desktop, mobile shows primary only. Primary = 'Register 1 Free', secondary = 'Request demo'.
Maya (Design): Uploaded designs + responsive rules. Preview: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/webinar-may18.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Form fields: first_name, last_name, email, company, company_size dropdown (<50 / 50-500 / 500+), role, gdpr_consent required. Hidden field: source_detail=webinar_may18.
Priya (Growth): Routing: company_size==500+ -> ae-queue, tag = "event:webinar_may18". utm_campaign=webinar_may18.
Dan (Growth): HubSpot props: lead_source, event_name, company_size_segment, source_detail. Attendance flag = attended_live boolean via Zoom webhook.
Sam (Events): Zoom: cloud recording + audio transcript ON, enable SRT output. Also local host recording as fallback. SRT endpoint -> srt://ingest.redwood.example:9003/webinar401. Infra confirmed for port 9003.
ZoomBot: Meeting created https://zoom.us/j/5556667777 (ID: 555-666-7777). SRT test scheduled May 16 09:00 PST.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Replay policy: 0-10 days open public replay. Day 11 -> gated (email capture) and clips available. Copy for gated page owned by Dan.
Maya (Design): Clip thumbs: need 3 aspect crops + speaker headshots. Sam will export clips; Dan will provide titles.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Privacy copy: "I agree to receive event-related emails." Save consent to HS property gdpr_consent. Export CSV daily: email, name, company, company_size_segment, utm_campaign, registration_ts, session_id, attended_live.
Priya (Growth): I'll set HS workflow for routing and AE notification for 500+ leads. Lock reg page and email copy by Monday 10am?
Leah (Marketing Ops): Yes please. Assigning tasks in Asana. React with :thumbsup: when complete.
